name: @liftr/backstage-integration
description: Liftr integration for Backstage: frontend plugin, constrained BFF backend plugin, shared public-API contracts, and a disposable host-app compatibility fixture. Backstage is a client of the Liftr public /v1 API only.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p plugins/liftr-common --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/liftr-backend --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/liftr --noEmit && tsc -p test-host --noEmit
scripts.test: vitest run && CI=true yarn workspace @liftr/plugin-liftr run test
scripts.verify:host: yarn workspace @liftr/testhost-backend build && yarn workspace @liftr/testhost-backend config:check && yarn workspace @liftr/testhost-app build && yarn workspace @liftr/testhost-app config:check
